name.value: Bee's Knees eBike Tours and Rentals

description.value: Bee's Knees eBike Tours and Rentals is a bicycle shop on Burrard Street in Vancouver offering eBike and regular bike rentals alongside a full repair workshop that accepts walk-ins without an appointment. The shop is also a guided tour operator, running multilingual tours through Stanley Park, Kitsilano, UBC, and Coal Harbour. Rental packages include helmet, lock, handlebar bag, and a bike map, making it a one-stop resource for visitors arriving without a bicycle.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces, covered) at 5m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 33m; stands (4 spaces) at 76m; stands (14 spaces) at 91m; stands (5 spaces) at 99m. Total: 31 spaces.

Guided tours with multilingual guides are described on the tours section, and the address on the website adds postal code V6Z 1Z7 not present in OSM but is otherwise identical.

E-bike service.detail: Services page lists 'Flat repair rear drive eBike' as a distinct service item, and the shop specialises in eBikes throughout its offerings

Bike rentals.detail: EBikes and regular bikes available in multiple rental durations (1 hour to 1 week); all rentals include helmet, lock, small handlebar bag, and a bike map. Baby seats and kids bike chariots also available as add-ons

Guided rides.detail: Guided tours offered through expert, multilingual guides covering Stanley Park and Seawall, Coal Harbour and Downtown Vancouver, Kitsilano and UBC, and 'The Big Hive'
